members.title: Workspace members
members.remove_message: This removes {user} from the workspace and signs them out.
members.seats_hint: Members plus pending invitations, against the plan's limit
members.seats_full: All {limit} seats of the plan are taken. To invite someone else, remove a member. Pending invitations take no seat until someone accepts, and get in only if a seat is free then.
members.license_free: Teams of more than {included} people are asked to buy a plan; nothing is limited. This install has {people}.
members.license_over: This license covers up to {included} people. This install has {people}, {over} over.
members.readonly: Only owners and admins can invite people or change roles.
members.role_change_message: {email} becomes {role} and has to sign in again.

remove_keys.one: Also revoke the {count} API key they created in this workspace
remove_keys.other: Also revoke the {count} API keys they created in this workspace

members.remove_keys_unknown: Also revoke the API keys they created in this workspace
members.remove_keys_hint: Keys you don't revoke keep working after they leave.
members.removed_keys: Member removed and their API keys revoked
members.owner_fixed_self: You own it. To hand the workspace to someone else, use {link} in Account.
members.owner_fixed_other: Only the owner can hand the workspace to someone else.

invite.hint: Someone who has never signed in gets an invitation and joins this workspace the first time they sign in.
invite.invited: Invitation saved. {email} joins this workspace the first time they sign in.
invite.invited_waiting: Invitation saved. {email} can sign in once they are on the access list.

delegation.title: Delegated chats
delegation.label: Let chats act for the person who opened them
delegation.help: With "Act for me" on, a chat's agent can create, edit and move tasks on every board for 8 hours. Deletions wait for that person to confirm them in the chat. Turning this off ends every delegation in force and revokes their keys. Owners only.

beta.title: Access list
beta.mode_allowlist: Only the emails on this list can sign up, and only with an email their identity provider has verified. Members of the operator workspace always get in.
beta.mode_open: Sign-up is open: anyone the identity provider authenticates can create an account. Set {env}=allowlist to require an invitation.
beta.load_failed: Could not load the access list.
beta.from_env: From {env}: change it there and restart
beta.remove_message: {email} won't be able to sign in again, and their open sessions end within minutes.

pending.title: Pending invitations
pending.link_copied: Link copied. It opens the sign-in page with this invitation.
pending.cancel_message: {email} won't join this workspace when they sign in.

login.title: Sign-in
login.hint: Read-only. Each value comes from an environment variable and changes with a restart.

signup_allowlist.one: By invitation: the Access list, plus {count} email from the environment
signup_allowlist.other: By invitation: the Access list, plus {count} emails from the environment

login.landing_personal: Gets a workspace of their own
login.landing_wait: Waits until an admin adds them
login.load_failed: Could not read the sign-in setup.
